progressFit.source: 保持全脑先验与共同噪声；所选测试源不参与重建器拟合
progressFit.en: Keeping the whole-brain prior and common noise level; selected test sources do not refit the decoder.

progressField.source: 将所选固定法向源共同传播到两套64点布局
progressField.en: Projecting the selected fixed-normal sources to both 64-electrode layouts.

receiverDisplay.source: 接收电位采用各布局64通道平均参考。两侧的电极颜色表示这一参考定义下实际坐标处的电位，单位μV；蓝为负、红为正，两侧及全部预览时间共用同一色标。接收图使用各自坐标；重建图和残差图均使用标准64平均参考目标场。点间不插值。
receiverDisplay.en: Received potentials use each layout's 64-channel average reference. Electrode colors show potentials at their actual coordinates in μV: blue is negative and red is positive. Both layouts and all preview frames share one scale. Reception views use each layout's coordinates; reconstruction and residual views use the standard-64 average-referenced target field. Values are not interpolated between electrodes.

instruction.source: 选择1–6个源区域，每区启用一个固定生成源。源点使用皮层法向；共享节律与各自波动叠加。总源均方能量固定，各源均分，不随选中数量增加。
instruction.en: Select 1–6 source regions, with one fixed generator per region. Sources use cortical-normal orientations and combine shared rhythms with individual fluctuations. Total mean-square source moment is fixed and divided equally among sources.

colors.source: 颜色对应DK图谱标签定义的六个研究区，与透视图中的分区和实际选源一致。
colors.en: Colors identify six research ROIs defined by DK atlas labels, shared by the cortex display and actual source selection.

empty.source: 至少选择一个源区域才能运行。
empty.en: Select at least one source region to run.

localProtocol.source: 在所选DK图谱研究区内选择6个固定生成源。节律/间歇波形和四组干扰对照保持不变；新分区结果使用独立缓存。
localProtocol.en: Select six fixed generators within the chosen DK-defined ROI. Rhythm/burst waveforms and four artifact comparisons are unchanged; atlas-defined results use separate cache identities.

legend.source: 颜色按Ernie皮层的DK图谱标签分组，选源与着色使用同一规则。灰色为其他皮层或分区边界。S编号标记实际生成源；点击图例调整视角。
legend.en: Colors group DK atlas labels on Ernie's cortex. Source selection and coloring share one rule. Gray marks other cortex or ROI boundaries. S labels identify actual generators; click a legend item to focus the view.

points.source: S编号标记为实际源点，颜色与所属源区域一致；选中源的曲线使用同色。
points.en: S labels mark actual generators. Marker colors match their source region and the selected source trace.

invalid.source: 跨区域模式需要选择1–6个不同的源区域
invalid.en: Select 1–6 distinct source regions for cross-region mode.

mapping.source: 跨区域源位置记录与选择不一致
mapping.en: The recorded cross-region sources do not match the selection.

methodTitle.source: 图谱分区与跨区域发生器

methodBody.source: 六组研究区由Ernie原生皮层上的Desikan–Killiany（DK40）标签合并定义，不是六个标准脑叶。中央区单列中央前回、中央后回和旁中央小叶；额叶组、顶叶组不再包含这些标签。脑岛、扣带及跨研究区边界三角面保留灰色。只有原始三角面三个顶点都属于同一研究区的生成源，才能用于该区。区域内模式从该区选择6源；跨区域模式每区选1源，代表点不随组合改变。坐标锚点只用于区内排序和视角导航，不决定区域归属。
methodBody.en: Six research ROIs merge Desikan–Killiany (DK40) labels on Ernie's native cortex; they are not six standard anatomical lobes. The sensorimotor group contains precentral, postcentral and paracentral labels, excluded from the frontal and parietal groups. Insular/cingulate cortex and triangles crossing ROI boundaries remain gray. A generator belongs to an ROI only when all three vertices of its original parent face share that ROI. Local mode selects six eligible sources; cross-region mode selects one stable representative per chosen ROI. Coordinate anchors rank sources only within an ROI and control camera navigation; they never determine membership.

atlasTable.source: 查看完整图谱标签映射

atlasLabels.source: 合并的DK图谱标签（左右半球，颞叶分左右）
atlasLabels.en: Merged DK labels (both hemispheres; temporal ROIs are lateralized)

atlasSource.source: 图谱与原始源数据核验记录

methodPower.source: 跨区域模式各源均分总偶极矩均方能量，合计RMS范数为10 nA·m；接收到的电位能量仍随位置、方向和源相关性变化。两套布局使用相同发生器，重建器仍由4096源先验固定计算。切换区域、波形或随机种子会形成不同缓存键；分区显示开关不参与计算。
methodPower.en: Cross-region sources share a fixed total mean-square dipole moment, with an aggregate RMS norm of 10 nA·m. Received potential energy still depends on positions, orientations, and source correlations. Both layouts use identical generators, and decoders remain fixed from the 4,096-source prior. Region, waveform, and seed changes identify different cached experiments; the partition display toggle does not affect computation.
